items.title: Charles Davis interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, August 23, 1997
items.q: I actually moved to New York in 1959. That’s when I started playing with Kenny Dorham.

ctx.x: What year did you move to New York?
I actually moved to New York in 1959. That’s when I started playing with Kenny Dorham.
There’s a guy who wrote a few good times.
